name: preflight-clarity
description: Pre-Flight Clarity — a research prototype testing whether a calm, data-rich pre-flight dashboard lowers flight anxiety.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w frontend" "npm run dev -w backend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w backend
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
